Give one example each of a native, a web and a hybrid app and one trade-off of each.

questions.q: In "Test on real devices and fix faults Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Explain what an app store does and why apps are reviewed.
Fix the worst faults first and run the tests again.
Use version control and commit often with clear notes.

questions.q: In "Release, price and look after users Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Repeat the full test list before each release.
Log every fault with steps to repeat, expected result and actual result.
Write a short support reply template and release notes in plain words.
Plan a breach response: who is told, how and when; check the current rules.

questions.q: In "Run the app as a real product Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Explain that anti-spam law needs consent before you send commercial messages.
Release to a small group first and set a stop rule.
